title: Interview: notifications
lead: Decide notification and conversation channels, recipients, timing and autonomy levels (Q9, X1–X2, C1–C5; ADRs 0025–0027).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Notifications should help without becoming noise, and a non-technical household member has to be OK with them.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. Channel per person: ntfy (self-hosted? which server?), email, or both?
2. Which pings: tonight's dinner/defrost (what time?), the weekly planning reminder, runout warnings, use-it-up?
3. Quiet hours?
4. Where does ntfy run (an existing instance, or add one to compose)? Is email sent via which SMTP?
5. Conversation mailbox: which provider and address? (Separate from the receipts mailbox, ADR 0025.) IMAP/SMTP sign-in method (app password or OAuth; check the provider's current rules).
6. Matrix: an existing homeserver or a self-hosted one (which)? Which client library (new dependency; state why, license and cost)?
7. Per person: which conversation channel(s), and which autonomy level (L0 or L1, ADR 0026)?
8. Command vocabulary: confirm the starter commands (add, low, list, what's low, help) and the numbered-reply format.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `local/` private notes (not committed)
- `docs/decisions/0024-notifications.md` (new)
- `docs/decisions/0025-conversational-channels.md`, `0026-autonomy-levels.md`, `0027-message-interpretation.md` (fill in deployment specifics)

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Ask the questions, including a non-technical household member's preferences.
2. Write ADR 0024; add the deployment specifics to ADRs 0025–0027; record the raw answers in `local/` (not committed); update the notifier and conversation slices.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- ADR 0024 lists each ping with its channel, recipient and time.
- Each person has a conversation channel and autonomy level recorded; the Matrix library decision states why, license and cost.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
